gaps.lead: He no longer thinks he can find a job before the end of the year.
gaps.sentence: He has given ___ a job before the end of the year.
gaps.explanation: 'No longer thinks he can find' becomes 'has given up hope of finding'.

gaps.lead: I think learning to use a typewriter is a waste of time.
gaps.sentence: I can't ___ how to use a typewriter.
gaps.explanation: 'A waste of time' becomes 'can't see the point in/of doing it'.

gaps.lead: The tickets cost so much that we stayed at home.
gaps.sentence: They were ___ we stayed at home.
gaps.explanation: so much (money) → such expensive tickets (no article with plurals).

gaps.lead: Yesterday, I informed my boss in writing that I would be leaving the company.
gaps.hint: inform your employer in writing = hand in your ___
gaps.explanation: 'Hand in one's notice' means formally resign.

gaps.lead: He spoke so quietly that the jury couldn't hear him.
gaps.sentence: He spoke ___ for the jury to hear him.
gaps.explanation: so quietly that nobody could hear = too quietly (for anybody) to hear.

gaps.lead: He can't be in Spain — I saw him here this morning.
gaps.sentence: He ___ in Spain — I saw him this morning.
gaps.explanation: can't/cannot possibly be = it is impossible that he is.
